briefdescription.para: Process incoming CAN frame on GB/T 27930 session.
Step session state machine timers and produce periodic CAN frames.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to CAN frame output buffer.

simplesect.para: true if tx_frame contains a CAN frame to transmit, false if idle.

briefdescription.para: GB/T 27930 (EV DC Fast Charging Protocol on SAE J1939 CAN Bus).

detaileddescription.para: Implements GB/T 27930-2015 / GB/T 27930-2024 EV DC Fast Charging Protocol state machine and framing for BMS (Vehicle, 0xF4) and Charger (EVSE, 0x56) nodes.
